request_reason: One RTX3090 suffices for Base within 12h. Source Large projects 31.2h singly; 3 ranks project 10.4h before observed ~15.5% NFE variation and extraction, so 4 are adequate. Paper-text Large projects 24.74h singly, 3 ranks 8.25h with observed ~12% cold/steady variation, so 3 are adequate. Estimates use one steady call; not measured full runtimes. Different world sizes prevent an isolated causal interval comparison.
alternative_resources_inspected: All current Torralba and allowed Vision/CSAIL Shared accelerators and partitions. The sole RTX3080 node is proven unhealthy; older Turing/V100 lack native TF32; RTX4090 has no measured throughput/runtime proof in this environment. Larger-VRAM A6000/L40S/A100/H100/H200 are unnecessary for measured peaks below 3GB. B1 uses the H100 pool; proposed RTX3090 jobs use separate resources.
